scope: Portability audit of the existing CampaignFsmV101 constructor and typed record-based skill-context loan. No production source was changed in this follow-up.

compile.platform_header_adaptation: Used the NDK's platform-neutral jni.h and an opaque AAssetManager forward declaration in a temporary .local-inputs include directory. The object has no undefined JNI, Java_*, Android, AAssetManager, or ANative symbols. No Android implementations or unresolved-symbol stubs were linked.
compile.legacy_box2d_adaptation: -Dfinite=_finite is needed for the repository's legacy Box2D header against the Windows CRT.
compile.warnings: Four unused-expression warnings originate in legacy Box2D headers.

context_creation.single_owner: CampaignFsmV101 is the existing sole FSM context stored in CanonicalCharacterCandidateRecordV60::fsm_context_v101. The typed loan does not create or replace it.

required_actual_inputs: actual record services and actor machine

loan_entry.behavior: Authenticates the supplied record against its already-stored CampaignFsmV101 and borrows its actual Session, PropertyView, SkillTables Borrow, SkillOwner, machine, and FSM-owned skill projections. A bare record with no stored FSM fails. This overload does not perform a World lookup or equate host actor IDs with native Character identities.

link_closure.interpretation: The Windows foundation target does not currently compile/link this translation unit. The record loan itself avoids the Android World lookup, but its owner is created by the renderer's campaign/process bind path. Linking the full existing translation unit also requires its model_renderer callbacks plus the level-world, script, animation, audio, effects, physics, player-manager, and canonical-record implementations; it is not a pure-record-only or windows-foundation-only link.

recommendation: Do not create a Windows-side second FSM or owner. For live integration, keep the existing CampaignFsmV101 constructor/binder as the only producer, let the host's explicit ActorId-to-canonical-record callback supply the already-published record, and invoke the record-based loan. A Windows runtime that must construct this graph needs the same native CampaignFsmV101 implementation and its actual model_renderer provider closure compiled into its native target through a platform-neutral boundary. The COFF compile shows this source file does not itself require Android link symbols; the unresolved boundary is the renderer/native-owner provider graph.
runtime_acceptance: Not claimed. No completed InitPost/InitFinal record with an active selected source Session was published for this audit.
